curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the three ways to avoid a collision and how to stop fast with and without antilock brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on collision options and emergency braking.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach evasive steering, when to leave the road, and when speeding up helps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on quick turns, hand positions and speeding up.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover deer season, spotting animals, and what to do when a crash seems unavoidable.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on deer habits and animal crash responses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain human error, the three parts of the highway system, and health and emotional fitness.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on crash causes and medical and emotional fitness.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover night vision, glasses, hearing, and avoiding fatigue.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on vision rules and fatigue.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the vehicle checks for brakes, lights, glass and tires.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each vehicle check, including the penny test.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the ignition, exhaust dangers, fuel, loose objects and the horn.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on exhaust safety and cabin habits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on engine and exhaust safety.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain moving with traffic and slowing at crowds, bridges, schools and railroad crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on traffic flow and special places.
